title: ShrineRow
description: A single shrine record as stored in the canonical dataset (data/shrines.json).

Name.description: Primary English name of the shrine or sacred site.

Founded/Opened.description: Year or century of founding, free-text (e.g. '1898', '16th century CE').

Sufi Saint.description: Name of the saint buried at or associated with the shrine.

Image 1.description: Primary image URL (must be http/https or empty).

Image 2.description: Secondary image URL (must be http/https or empty).

Events.description: Description of annual events, urs celebrations, etc.

Description.description: Main prose description of the shrine.
